name: Ximac Diri
aliases: Hivelord Ximac Diri of the Second
desc:
Ximac Diri was a character mentioned in Lament of Cirryn. With the book's removal from the game, Ximac is no longer referenced within _Deepwoken_.

Ximac was the Hivelord of the Second, one of [The Hive](faction:the_hive)'s Greathives.
